about: Video Academy look registry (ADR-26). One entry per built-in video look: id (ASCII kebab-case, matches the skill's look package), tier (free | pro), display name and a one-line 'suits' hint per locale. Edit this file to add, remove or re-tier a look; the plugin's style menus and the copy written to engram-quest/videos/looks.json for the video skill both come from here.
